text:
The brownfield change specification for entity former names (`backstage.io/previous-names`) and rename redirects has been submitted and validated across all sections:

- **`header.json`**: Conventions, 5 architectural decisions, `prettier` file check, and the fixed `test-typecheck-lint` project check (`CI=true yarn test plugins/catalog-backend plugins/catalog plugins/techdocs && yarn tsc && yarn lint:all`).
- **`units-001.json` (`U01`–`U19`)**:
  - `@backstage/catalog-model`: `ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES` and `parseEntityPreviousNames` (`U01`–`U03`).
  - `@backstage/plugin-catalog-backend`: Knex migration `20261104000000_previous_entity_names.js` (`final_entity_previous_names` with FK `ON DELETE CASCADE` to `final_entities`), `DbFinalEntityPreviousNamesRow`, stitcher synchronization in `performStitching.ts`, `DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityRedirect` (leaving `entitiesBatch` and existing query shapes in `queries.md` untouched), `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entityRedirect`, OpenAPI specification in `openapi.yaml`, OpenAPI code generation tooling step (`yarn generate`), and `GET /entities/by-name/:kind/:namespace/:name/redirect` route in `createRouter.ts` (`U04`–`U12`).
  - `@backstage/catalog-client`: `CatalogEntityRedirect`, `CatalogApi.getEntityRedirectByRef`, `CatalogClient.getEntityRedirectByRef`, and `InMemoryCatalogClient.getEntityRedirectByRef` (`U13`–`U16`).
  - `@backstage/plugin-catalog` & `@backstage/plugin-techdocs`: Redirect fallback, sub-route/query/hash preservation, `replace: true` navigation, and transient info alert in `useEntityFromUrl.ts` and `useExternalRedirect.ts`, followed by API/SQL report generation (`U17`–`U19`).
- **`units-002.json` (`U20`–`U30`)**: Unit and integration tests across `catalog-model`, `catalog-backend`, `catalog-client`, `catalog` (legacy and new frontend system), and `techdocs` (hook and reader page).
- **`units-003.json` (`U31`–`U33`)**: Documentation in `docs/features/software-catalog/well-known-annotations.md` and `docs/features/software-catalog/api.md` (explicitly noting that another entity of the same kind claiming the same former name turns that redirect into a 404) and changeset `.changeset/entity-rename-redirects.md`.
